product_title: Royal Peacock & Lotus Pearl Door Hangings
product_description: Add a touch of traditional elegance to your home with this handcrafted pair of door hangings, featuring vibrant peacock motifs, pink lotus designs, divine artwork, and intricate golden detailing. Finished with beautiful pearl tassels, they are perfect for festive entrances, pooja rooms, Diwali, and housewarming celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle decorative elements and pearl tassels with care.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
